compare.originalNote: Saved replies from the original conversation. These are reference material only.
compare.unavailable: No original reply is available for this message. It may have expired, failed, or the script was edited.
compare.settingsNote: Editors open in a new tab. Save your correction there, then return here and explicitly run the test. Saving settings does not change old answers or start a run.
compare.scripted: Reruns follow these scripted customer messages even if the agent answers differently. Every agent reply is generated fresh using current saved shop facts. Compare the answers yourself; there is no automatic grade.
compare.prepare: View scenario and correct shop facts

savedTests.title: Saved tests
savedTests.intro: Situations you saved on purpose. Run one again after you fix your agent's setup, then check the new reply yourself.
savedTests.empty: No saved tests yet. In the practice chat, choose “Save as test” on a question you want to check again.
savedTests.saved: Saved. This test and its selected attachments stay until you delete it.
savedTests.setupChanged: Your agent's setup changed after this run.

run.expectedNote: Provided by you. It can be out of date.
run.expectedSeparate: Updating the expected answer is separate: it changes the test, not this result, and does not mark this reply as accepted.
run.expired: The reply from this run was deleted after seven days. Your review is kept.
run.outdated: You edited this test after this run. The expected answer shown is the one from the run.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this test?
confirmDelete.body: The test, its attachments and its run results are removed. This cannot be undone.

form.label: Save a practice test
form.title: Test name
form.scriptHint: Only these customer messages are replayed. Check them and remove anything unrelated or personal.
form.followUpWarning: The agent writes fresh replies each time. A scripted follow-up may stop making sense if its answers change; edit the test or try it in the practice chat then.
form.expectedHint: Your own reference for what a good reply says. The agent never sees it, and it is not checked automatically.
form.persists: This test and its selected attachments stay until you delete it.

problem.title: Give the test a name.
problem.turns: Keep at least one customer message.
problem.turn_empty: Every kept customer message needs text or an attachment.

review.title: Your review
review.hint: This records your opinion of this one reply. It does not prove the facts are right.
review.expired: This reply has expired, so it can no longer be reviewed. Run the test again.
review.notReady: You can review the reply once the run has finished.

paymentDelivery.phoneWarning: This phone number is not in your payment accounts.

phoneAlerts.title: Phone alerts
phoneAlerts.hint: Get a notification on this phone when the shop needs you. It never shows customer names or messages.
phoneAlerts.loadFailed: Could not load phone alerts. Please try again.
phoneAlerts.notConfigured: Phone alerts are not available right now.
phoneAlerts.onDraft: New drafts waiting for your approval
phoneAlerts.onDraftHint: Get an alert when the AI writes a reply for you to approve. After an alert for a chat, the next one for that chat waits ten minutes.
phoneAlerts.onEscalationHint: Get an alert when the AI hands a chat over to you. Owners and the person the chat is assigned to are told.
phoneAlerts.onAssignmentHint: Get an alert when a teammate assigns a chat to you. Assigning a chat to yourself does not alert you.
phoneAlerts.switchFailed: Could not save this setting. Please try again.
phoneAlerts.signedOut: Off: you signed out on this phone. Turn it on again.

guidance.inAppBrowser: This in-app browser cannot show alerts. Open this page in Chrome or Safari, then turn alerts on.
guidance.iosInstall: On iPhone, alerts work from the installed app. Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, open Karbaar from the Home Screen and turn alerts on there.
guidance.unsupported: This browser does not support phone alerts. Try Chrome on Android, or Safari with the app added to your Home Screen.
guidance.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back and turn alerts on.

notice.enabled: Alerts are on for this phone.
notice.denied: Notifications were not allowed, so alerts stay off. You can allow them in your browser's site settings.
notice.dismissed: You did not choose an answer, so alerts stay off. Press Turn on to try again.
notice.failed: Could not turn alerts on. Please try again.
notice.conflict: This browser cannot be used for alerts right now. Reset the site's notification permission in the browser settings, then turn alerts on again.
notice.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
notice.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive on this phone in a moment.
notice.testFailed: Could not send the test. Turn alerts on again and retry.

takeovers.title: Ordinary takeovers
takeovers.explanation: Hand back ordinary takeovers after teammate inactivity. Unresolved escalations have no timer. Mark handled resolves an escalation while keeping AI paused; Hand back also lifts the pause. Timers never change your AI mode.
takeovers.laterDeferral: Later defers automatic hand-back until it ends. Hand back overrides Later.
takeovers.suggestion: Forgotten takeovers can return to AI after an hour of teammate inactivity. Unresolved escalations are excluded. Your current default is Never.

handedBack.off: Handed back. AI is off for this shop.
handedBack.draft: Handed back. Eligible unanswered messages can get a draft for your approval.
handedBack.auto: Handed back. Eligible unanswered messages follow your current Auto controls.
handedBack.unknown: Handed back. Current shop AI controls still apply.
